item.title: Major fire overnight at five star Fiordland Lodge
item.description: The luxury Fiordland Lodge near Te Anau. Photo: Supplied A large number of firefighters have worked through the night to contain a fire which broke out at a luxury lodge on the outskirts of Te Anau.

item.title: Bus crash causes disruptions on Portobello Rd
item.description: Emergency services at the scene of the crash this morning. Photo: Gregor Richardson A crash between a car and a bus is causing disruptions on Portobello Rd.

item.title: 12-month prescriptions now available
item.description: File photo: Getty Images Twelve-month prescriptions for long-term medications take effect from today.

item.title: Running prodigy Ruthe smashes world, NZ mile records
item.description: Kiwi teenager Sam Ruthe has smashed the U18 world record for the mile and put the athletics world on notice with a phenomenal run at an indoor meet in Boston.

item.title: Police issue warning after fatal Glenorchy crash
item.description: Police say there have been "too many crashes" on Southern roads this weekend. Photo: ODT files One person has died and another is in a serious condition after a crash in Glenorchy this morning, prompting a "firm message" from Southern police.

item.title: Student stalked, harassed former teacher, then had affair with her husband
item.description: The woman sent the victim this, but unpixelated, photo of herself, taken inside the victim's bathroom. Photo: Supplied By Jeremy Wilkinson of Open Justice

item.title: Family comforted teen landslide victims spent final days together
item.description: Max Furse-Kee and Sharon Maccanico were on holiday together with her family, when they were killed in the massive landslide that swept away four other people at a Mt Maunganui campground. Photo: Supplied/ Police "There was nothing that could have prepared us for this."

item.title: History awaits as Djokovic and Alcaraz meet in Australian Open final
item.description: Serbia's Novak Djokovic celebrates winning his semi final match against Italy's Jannik Sinner. Photos: Reuters Novak Djokovic and Carlos Alcaraz meet in Sunday's Australian Open final with history in the balance, as the Serbian great chases a record 25th Grand Slam title and the Spanish dynamo bids to become the youngest man to win all four majors.
